name: A2A
summary: Agent2Agent (A2A) is an open protocol for agents built on different frameworks and by different vendors to discover each other and delegate tasks. Agents publish Agent Cards describing their capabilities; work is exchanged over JSON-RPC, gRPC or HTTP+JSON bindings. Google created it and donated it to the Linux Foundation; it joined the Agentic AI Foundation in August 2026.
facts: Python, JavaScript, Java, C#/.NET, Go, Rust
goodFor: Agents from different vendors working together
Delegating long-running tasks to remote agents
Enterprise platforms with native support (Google Cloud, Bedrock AgentCore, Azure AI Foundry)
watchOut: v1.0 has breaking changes from v0.3
Adds a second protocol alongside MCP to learn and secure
Less useful when all agents live in one codebase
